fullDescription: Vibrant Art Deco design system featuring a high-energy primary palette (fuchsia #FF1493, turquoise #00D9FF, orange #FF6B35, lime #00FF41) on a sophisticated ivory (#FFFEF9) base. Incorporates maximalist geometric patterns, sunburst gradients, and editorial typography (Playfair Display and Josefin Sans). Ideal for high-end fashion, artisan jewelry, luxury lifestyle, and creative brand storytelling that balances classic sophistication with modern electric energy.
prompt:
## Resumo
A maximalist Art Deco-inspired design system that replaces traditional dark/gold themes with a vibrant, high-contrast primary color palette. The aesthetic combines symmetrical geometric ornamentation, shimmering text effects, and a refined ivory background to create a sophisticated yet energetic luxury experience.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a 'Vibrant Art Deco' aesthetic with an ivory background (#FFFEF9) and charcoal text (#2D2D2D). Use a palette of fuchsia (#FF1493), turquoise (#00D9FF), orange (#FF6B35), and electric lime (#00FF41) for accents. 

### Typography
- **Headers**: 'Playfair Display', bold weights, italicize secondary words for flair. 
- **Body**: 'Cormorant Garamond', font-size 18px-24px, 1.6 line-height. 
- **UI/Labels**: 'Josefin Sans', uppercase, tracking: 0.3em, weight 500. 

### Decorative Elements
- **Patterns**: Backgrounds should feature an Art Deco geometric lattice using 2% opacity fuchsia/turquoise gradients (linear-gradient at 30 and -30 degrees).
- **Borders**: Use 2px solid vibrant colors or multi-color gradients (#FF1493 to #00D9FF) for buttons and cards.
- **Sunbursts**: Implement slow-rotating (60s) conic-gradients with 6% opacity of primary colors.

### Interactions & Effects
- **Shimmer**: Apply a moving text gradient (shimmer-vibrant) cycling through all primary colors at 4s intervals. 
- **Hover States**: Cards should translate -8px Y-axis with a dual-color glow shadow (fuchsia/turquoise opacity 0.15).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed header, height 80px, bg ivory #FFFEF9/95. Layout is symmetrical: center logo flanked by two navigation groups. Include 1px gold bottom border (#D4A84B/30). Logo should be framed by horizontal gradient lines (16px width) and small diamond (◆) glyphs in vibrant colors.

### Hero Section
Centered layout with background conic-gradient sunburst. Feature large H1 (8xl) in Playfair Display with one word using the 'shimmer-vibrant' animated gradient. Include corner SVG ornaments (L-shapes) in primary colors. CTA buttons: one solid fuchsia (#FF1493) and one outlined turquoise (#00D9FF) with 2px borders.

### Category Grid
3-column grid of vertical aspect-ratio (3:4) cards. Each card has a different vibrant gradient background (e.g., fuchsia to fuchsia-dark). Include an internal 2px inset ivory border (16px from edges) and large centralized icons at 30% opacity. Use absolute positioned diamond (◆) glyphs in all four corners.

### Product Gallery
4-column grid. Cards feature an ivory background with 2px borders matching the product's primary accent color. Top section is square (1:1) with a 10% opacity color-tinted background. Badges should be rectangular, solid fuchsia or turquoise, with white uppercase labels. Footer of card contains product name in Playfair Display and price in Cormorant Garamond.

### Heritage/Quote Section
Full-width section with a diagonal gradient (fuchsia to turquoise to orange). Centralized blockquote in large italic Playfair Display (5xl). Include a decorative internal frame (inset 64px) using 2px ivory borders with diamond glyphs at each corner.

### Footer
Charcoal background (#2D2D2D). 4-column layout: Brand info, Collections, Support, Contact. Social icons are circular, 40px diameter, with 1px vibrant color borders. Include a 'deco-line' (2px height gradient) before the copyright section.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Vibrant Shimmer Text — Multi-color animated gradient text that creates a moving light effect.
Apply a linear-gradient (90deg, #FF1493, #00D9FF, #FF6B35, #00FF41, #FF1493) to the text. Set background-size to 200% auto. Use background-clip: text and -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent. Animate the background-position from 0% to 200% over 4 seconds, linear and infinite.

### Art Deco Category Card — Highly decorative card using gradients and geometric symmetry.
Container: 3:4 aspect ratio, relative positioning, overflow hidden. Background: linear-gradient(135deg, [PrimaryColor], [DarkerTone]). Overlay: Inset white 2px border (spacing 16px). Icon: Centered iconify-icon at text-8xl scale, 30% opacity. Labeling: Absolute bottom p-8, label in Josefin Sans (12px, tracking 0.3em), heading in Playfair Display (3xl).

### Deco-Line Divider — A sophisticated horizontal divider using the vibrant palette.
Height: 2px. Background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #FF1493 20%, #00D9FF 40%, #FF6B35 60%, #00FF41 80%, transparent). Used to separate sections or footer elements.

style.description: The style is 'Vibrant Art Deco' characterized by the use of four primary electric hues (Fuchsia #FF1493, Turquoise #00D9FF, Orange #FF6B35, and Lime #00FF41) against a warm Ivory background (#FFFEF9). Typography is a mix of high-contrast serif (Playfair Display) for display headers, refined serif (Cormorant Garamond) for body, and geometric sans (Josefin Sans) with heavy tracking (0.2em - 0.4em) for labels and UI elements. Animations include linear gradient shimmers, color-cycling text, and slow-rotating conic gradients.
